SELECT
    toYear(fs.DateKey) AS SalesYear,
    toQuarter(fs.DateKey) AS SalesQuarter,
    sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS TotalSalesAmount,
    sum(fs.TotalCost) AS TotalCost,
    sum(fs.SalesAmount) - sum(fs.TotalCost) AS GrossProfit,
    round((sum(fs.SalesAmount) - sum(fs.TotalCost)) / nullIf(sum(fs.SalesAmount), 0) * 100, 2) AS GrossMarginPct,
    sum(fs.SalesQuantity) AS TotalUnitsSold,
    sum(fs.ReturnQuantity) AS TotalReturns,
    sum(fs.ReturnAmount) AS TotalReturnAmount,
    sum(fs.DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscounts
FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
JOIN retail.DimProduct AS dp ON fs.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS dps ON dp.ProductSubcategoryKey = dps.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS dpc ON dps.ProductCategoryKey = dpc.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE dpc.ProductCategoryName = 'Cameras'
GROUP BY SalesYear, SalesQuarter
ORDER BY SalesYear, SalesQuarter
